sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Lately, I've been covering a lot of funerals.
sentences.zh: 最近，我一直在报道很多葬礼。

sentences.en: I find myself at the graveside, surrounded by family members.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己站在墓地旁，周围都是家属。

sentences.en: I put myself in their situation and what would I do if I had lost my mother or if I had lost my father or one of my siblings to this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我把自己代入他们的处境，如果我在这场大流行中失去了母亲、父亲或兄弟姐妹中的某一个，我会怎么做。

sentences.en: Sadly, the feeling is quite familiar in a sense that I've spent so much of my career covering death and covering these really traumatic moments.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这种感觉在某种程度上相当熟悉，因为我的大半职业生涯都在报道死亡和这些真正痛苦的时刻。

sentences.en: My name is Lindsay Adario.
sentences.zh: 我叫琳赛·阿达里奥。

sentences.en: We've been reporting on the dire situation in Somalia where a devastating famine has only been spreading.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在报道索马里严峻的形势，那里的毁灭性饥荒一直在蔓延。

sentences.en: And I have spent the better part of the last two decades covering conflict and humanitarian crises.
sentences.zh: 在过去二十年的大部分时间里，我一直在报道冲突和人道主义危机。

sentences.en: Now we've got some truly important images to share with you, taken by award-winning photojournalist
sentences.zh: 现在我们有一些非常重要的影像要与大家分享，这些照片是由屡获殊荣的摄影记者

sentences.en: Lindsay Adario.
sentences.zh: 琳赛·阿达里奥拍摄的。

sentences.en: In most of my experiences covering Iraq and Afghanistan and Democratic Republic of Congo
sentences.zh: 在我报道伊拉克、阿富汗、刚果民主共和国

sentences.en: and Darfur, I'm photographing people who are trying not to die, who are trying to stay alive at all costs.
sentences.zh: 和达尔富尔的大多数经历中，我拍摄的都是那些试图不死去、不惜一切代价活下来的人。

sentences.en: Marike was the first person I had really met who wanted to die.
sentences.zh: 马里克是我真正遇到的第一个渴望死亡的人。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I hear you talking with Mrs. Marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 我听见你在和棉花糖夫人说话。

sentences.en: I had never met or photographed anyone who would constantly talk about how much she was looking forward to that moment where she could finally be at peace.
sentences.zh: 我从未遇到或拍摄过这样的人，她会不断谈论自己是多么期待那个终于能获得平静的时刻。

sentences.en: You know that I even don't know lots of pieces of the week.
sentences.zh: 你知道我甚至对这一周的许多细节都记不清了。

sentences.en: I don't know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And peace for her was death.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，平静就是死亡。

sentences.en: And the rest is counting down that I can die.
sentences.zh: 而剩下的时间就是倒计时，等待我可以死去。

sentences.en: Whereas in the world that I had come from, peace for the people I photographed meant no war.
sentences.zh: 然而在我出身的世界里，我拍摄的人所理解的平静意味着没有战争。

sentences.en: It certainly did not mean death.
sentences.zh: 那绝对不意味着死亡。

sentences.en: It meant the antithesis of death.
sentences.zh: 那意味着死亡的对立面。

sentences.en: A lot of people, it's very sad, but I'm very happy.
sentences.zh: 很多人觉得这非常悲伤，但我很高兴。

sentences.en: She wanted to show that death could be peaceful, that it was something that she was choosing.
sentences.zh: 她想表明死亡可以是平静的，这是她自己的选择。

sentences.en: So, um, just let me know what you think about it.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，请告诉我你对此有何看法。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Two decades ago, Belgium passed the world's most liberal euthanasia laws, allowing thousands of patients who suffer severe medical conditions to end their lives.
sentences.zh: 二十年前，比利时通过了世界上最宽容的安乐死法律，允许数千名饱受严重病情折磨的患者结束生命。

sentences.en: But nearly 20 years later, the process remains fraught for those trying to die, as well as their families.
sentences.zh: 但在近20年后，对于那些试图安乐死的人以及他们的家属来说，这个过程依然充满坎坷。

sentences.en: Today, photojournalist Lindsay Adario documented one woman's experience.
sentences.zh: 今天，摄影记者琳赛·阿达里奥记录了一位女性的经历。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月24日，星期一。

sentences.en: In 2017, the New York Times sent me and writer Andrew Kay to profile Marika Vervoer.
sentences.zh: 2017年，《纽约时报》派遣我和作家安德鲁·凯去为马里卡·韦沃尔做人物专访。

sentences.en: Marika had been very public about her desire to do euthanasia, and we thought it would be an interesting profile
sentences.zh: 马里卡对她想要实施安乐死的愿望一直公开坦荡，我们觉得这会是一个有趣的专访

sentences.en: to go get a better sense of why, of what her daily life was like that was inspiring this real drive to end her life.
sentences.zh: 去更好地了解原因，了解她的日常生活是什么样的，从而激发了她真正想要结束生命的动力。

sentences.en: But I didn't know much about Marika when I first got the assignment.
sentences.zh: 但刚接到任务时，我对马里卡知之甚少。

sentences.en: All I knew was that she was a very accomplished Paralympic athlete from Belgium.
sentences.zh: 我只知道她是一位来自比利时的成就卓著的残奥会运动员。

sentences.en: And when I started to do some research on her, I couldn't believe how much she had accomplished.
sentences.zh: 当我开始对她进行一些研究时，我简直不敢相信她取得了如此巨大的成就。

sentences.en: She had won four Paralympic medals.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了四枚残奥会奖牌。

sentences.en: Four world records for track.
sentences.zh: 四项田径世界纪录。

sentences.en: She was the world champion of the triathlon twice.
sentences.zh: 她曾两次获得铁人三项世界冠军。

sentences.en: So a new Paralympic record, Marika Vervoer, 1969.
sentences.zh: 又一项残奥会纪录，马里卡·韦沃尔，1969年生。

sentences.en: 20.40 seconds for Marika Vervoer.
sentences.zh: 马里卡·韦沃尔的成绩是20秒40。

sentences.en: So she takes the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 因此她夺得了金牌。

sentences.en: And competed in the Ironman in Hawaii in her wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 并且坐在轮椅上完成了夏威夷铁人三项赛。

sentences.en: Three medals now, all gold for the Belgian.
sentences.zh: 现在是三枚奖牌，全部都是比利时人的金牌。

sentences.en: Four of the finalists can be very pleased with what they did, but it's Vervoer of Belgium who's got the record and the gold.
sentences.zh: 四位决赛选手对他们的表现都会非常满意，但打破纪录并夺得金牌的是比利时的韦沃尔。

sentences.en: She was just this incredible force of nature.
sentences.zh: 她就像一股不可思议的自然力量。

sentences.en: Vervoer has a degenerative spinal condition that leaves her in extreme pain and says she sometimes sleeps only 10 minutes a night and needs around-the-clock care.
sentences.zh: 韦沃尔患有一种退行性脊椎疾病，这使她承受着极大的痛苦，她说自己有时一晚只能睡10分钟，并且需要全天候的照料。

sentences.en: In fact, she was recently quoted as saying that after the Rio Games, she was considering euthanasia, which is legal in Belgium.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她最近被引述说，在里约残奥会之后，她正在考虑安乐死，这在比利时是合法的。

sentences.en: Today, she clarified those reports.
sentences.zh: 今天，她对这些报道作出了澄清。

sentences.en: In 2016, Marika held a press conference and she announced that the Rio Games would be her last and she was retiring from professional sports.
sentences.zh: 2016年，马里卡举行了一场新闻发布会，宣布里约残奥会将是她的最后一届比赛，她将从职业体育界退役。

sentences.en: Yes, this is my last Paralympic Games.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我的最后一届残奥会。

sentences.en: I have a progressive disease and I signed my euthanasia papers already in 2008 because it's really, really hard to handle and to suffer with this disease.
sentences.zh: 我患有进行性疾病，我早在2008年就签署了安乐死文件，因为应对和忍受这种疾病实在、实在是太痛苦了。

sentences.en: But the euthanasia, it gives me a feeling of reSt. I live with a good feeling, whatever what happened.
sentences.zh: 但安乐死给了我一种平静的感觉。无论发生什么，我都带着美好的感觉生活。

sentences.en: I have my papers in my hand, but I'm still enjoying every little moment.
sentences.zh: 我手里拿着文件，但我仍然在享受每一个微小的时刻。

sentences.en: Well, when the moment comes that I have more bad days than good days, then I have my euthanasia papers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当糟糕的日子多于美好的日子的那一刻到来时，我就会拿出我的安乐死文件。

sentences.en: I remember the first time I met Marika, I remember watching her being wheeled out by her nurse, Anne.
sentences.zh: 我记得我第一次见到马里卡时，我记得看着她被护士安推出来。

sentences.en: She wore a Nike tracksuit and she had this white blonde spiky hair that she used gel to spike straight up.
sentences.zh: 她穿着耐克运动服，留着一头白金色的尖刺状短发，用发胶把头发梳得直立起来。

sentences.en: She sort of gave this air of like, no bullshit.
sentences.zh: 她身上有一种不废话、不来虚的的爽快气场。

sentences.en: She sort of greeted Andrew and I like, okay, you know, here you are.
sentences.zh: 她迎接我和安德鲁的方式仿佛在说，好吧，你知道的，你来了。

sentences.en: This is what we're going to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们要做的。

sentences.en: And off we went.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就出发了。

sentences.en: I think she just assumed it would be, you know, one or two trips to visit her and write a piece on her life.
sentences.zh: 我想她当时只是以为，你知道的，只会拜访她一两次，然后写一篇关于她生活的文章。

sentences.en: But it ended up being almost three years that we spent with her.
sentences.zh: 但最终我们和她在一起度过了将近三年的时间。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My breath don't eat from us.
sentences.zh: 我的呼吸不要从我们这儿拿走。

sentences.en: What do I have to say?
sentences.zh: 我该说些什么？

sentences.en: I just want to talk about how you're feeling.
sentences.zh: 我只想谈谈你的感受。

sentences.en: Just because now we've known each other for eight months.
sentences.zh: 只因为现在我们已经认识八个月了。

sentences.en: Yeah, since that eight months, a lot changed.
sentences.zh: 对，自那八个月以来，发生了很多变化。

sentences.en: Eight months ago, I had still good times, but now they're only bad times.
sentences.zh: 八个月前，我还有过美好的时光，但现在只有糟糕的时光了。

sentences.en: And the control over my hands is going slowly more and more away.
sentences.zh: 我对双手的控制力正在一点一点慢慢消失。

sentences.en: Not this night, but the night before, three times I lost control over my hands.
sentences.zh: 不是昨晚，而是前天晚上，我三次失去了对双手的控制。

sentences.en: But then I cried really hard the whole night because what is going on here?
sentences.zh: 然后我整晚都在放声大哭，因为这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I'm really scared.
sentences.zh: 我真的很害怕。

sentences.en: I'm so scared.
sentences.zh: 我好害怕。

sentences.en: So what scares you?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么让你害怕？

sentences.en: Are you afraid of dying?
sentences.zh: 你害怕死亡吗？

sentences.en: Are you afraid of the pain?
sentences.zh: 你害怕疼痛吗？

sentences.en: Are you afraid of...
sentences.zh: 你害怕……

sentences.en: What makes you scared?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你感到害怕？

sentences.en: What's the next thing that's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Marike often described her pain as a pain so much that her mind could handle it, but her body just couldn't.
sentences.zh: 马里克经常将她的疼痛描述为一种超出她心理承受能力、但身体却无法承受的剧痛。

sentences.en: Suddenly, she would start shaking.
sentences.zh: 突然间，她开始颤抖。

sentences.en: Often it would start with her leg.
sentences.zh: 通常是从她的腿开始。

sentences.en: And then it would sort of envelop her entire body.
sentences.zh: 然后它会蔓延到她的全身。

sentences.en: She would start coughing or choking.
sentences.zh: 她会开始咳嗽或窒息。

sentences.en: And suddenly she would have an all-body seizure.
sentences.zh: 突然间，她会全身抽搐。

sentences.en: At this point, I had known Marike almost a year.
sentences.zh: 此时，我认识马里克已经快一年了。

sentences.en: I had seen her through some pretty horrific nights.
sentences.zh: 我陪她度过了许多相当可怕的夜晚。

sentences.en: But I still was sort of reckoning with how difficult it is to decide when to die.
sentences.zh: 但我仍在思考决定何时死亡是多么困难的一件事。

sentences.en: I had never really seen someone make these decisions.
sentences.zh: 我从未真正见过有人做出这样的决定。

sentences.en: And really, the things that went into consideration.
sentences.zh: 以及其中真正需要权衡的事情。

sentences.en: Belgium is one of a handful of countries where euthanasia is legal for non-terminally ill patients.
sentences.zh: 比利时是少数几个对非绝症患者实行安乐死合法的国家之一。

sentences.en: The requirements, though, are pretty rigorous.
sentences.zh: 不过，要求相当严格。

sentences.en: You know, for Marike, in addition to the sort of bureaucracy and the logistics of getting the signatures, you know, there were really emotional decisions to make.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对于马里克来说，除了官僚作风和收集签名的后勤工作之外，你知道的，还有真正艰难的情感抉择要做。

sentences.en: I have to choose a date and an hour and who had to stay with me when it has to happen.
sentences.zh: 我必须选择一个日期和一个时间，以及当事情发生时谁必须陪在我身边。

sentences.en: That's really, really, really difficult to say that.
sentences.zh: 说出这句话真的、真的很困难。

sentences.en: And as long as I had known Marike and as much pain as she was in, she still had not selected a date to die.
sentences.zh: 只要我认识马里克，无论她经受着多大的痛苦，她仍然没有选定死去的日期。

sentences.en: How will you know when the right time is?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道什么时候是合适的时间？

sentences.en: I mean, how does someone know when the time is right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一个人怎么知道什么时候时机成熟？

sentences.en: I feel now that my time is upcoming.
sentences.zh: 我现在觉得我的时间快到了。

sentences.en: Is there a limit to the people you can have in the room?
sentences.zh: 房间里能容纳的人数有限制吗？

sentences.en: Like, is there a number, a maximum number, or you decide how you want it?
sentences.zh: 比如，有没有一个数字，最大人数限制，还是你自己决定你想要怎样？

sentences.en: Uh, I decided for myself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我自己决定。

sentences.en: But I decided already that I say first goodbye to my parents before I go to the room.
sentences.zh: 但我已经决定了，在我去那个房间之前，先向我的父母告别。

sentences.en: Marike was pretty adamant that she did not want her parents in the room when she ended her life.
sentences.zh: 马里克非常坚持，她结束生命时不想让父母在房间里。

sentences.en: I think in the beginning her parents were not supportive of Marike's decision to do euthanasia.
sentences.zh: 我想一开始她的父母并不支持马里克实施安乐死的决定。

sentences.en: And they finally came around.
sentences.zh: 他们最终改变了态度。

sentences.en: But I think that period where they just could not come on board really angered Marike.
sentences.zh: 但我想他们无法接受的那段时期真的让马里克很生气。

sentences.en: And she felt like she wouldn't be able to go through with it if they were there watching her.
sentences.zh: 她觉得自己如果看到他们在那里看着她，她就无法完成这件事。

sentences.en: I think it was sort of her way of protecting them by not letting them see her pass away.
sentences.zh: 我想这可以说是她保护他们的一种方式，不让他们看到她离世。

sentences.en: And it was causing a huge amount of stress, not only for Marike, but for her parents.
sentences.zh: 这造成了巨大的压力，不仅对马里克，对她的父母也是如此。

sentences.en: Marike's mother and I ended up spending a fair amount of time together.
sentences.zh: 马里克的母亲和我最终花了不少时间在一起。

sentences.en: We would go and have tea down in the cafeteria in the hospital when we were both sitting by her bedside.
sentences.zh: 当我们俩都坐在她病床边时，我们会去医院底楼的自助餐厅喝茶。

sentences.en: Or on occasion, Marike's mother would invite me back to her apartment to have a glass of champagne.
sentences.zh: 或者有时，马里克的母亲会邀请我去她的公寓喝一杯香槟。

sentences.en: And one evening, I had gone to see Marike, and she was sleeping for hours.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，我去探望马里克，她已经睡了几个小时。

sentences.en: And her mother, Odette, said, come to my house.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲奥黛特说，来我家吧。

sentences.en: It was a few minutes' walk from the hospital.
sentences.zh: 离医院只有几分钟的步行路程。

sentences.en: And it's because I feel good with you.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我和你在一起感觉很好。

sentences.en: I feel you are...
sentences.zh: 我觉得你是……

sentences.en: And she took out a goodbye letter that she had written to Marike.
sentences.zh: 然后她拿出一封她写给马里克的告别信。

sentences.en: Her English wasn't perfect at the time, but she really wanted to read it to me in English.
sentences.zh: 当时她的英语说得不是太完美，但她真的很想用英语读给我听。

sentences.en: I showed you the back, open, and then I feel your hair.
sentences.zh: 我向你展示背面，打开，然后我摸到你的头发。

sentences.en: What will you give her that?
sentences.zh: 你会给她这个吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Why don't you just tell her what you want to tell her?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不直接把你想告诉她的告诉她呢？

sentences.en: A few weeks after reading me that letter, Odette collapsed in the bathroom and was rushed to the hospital,
sentences.zh: 读给我听那封信几周后，奥黛特在浴室里晕倒并被紧急送往医院，

sentences.en: where she was put into an induced coma and ended up staying there for several months.
sentences.zh: 在那里她被实施了人工昏迷，并在那里呆了好几个月。

sentences.en: It was unclear whether she would even survive.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚她是否能活下来。

sentences.en: My mother landed up in intensive care.
sentences.zh: 我母亲最终住进了重症监护室。

sentences.en: Many times, the doctor said, prepare yourself.
sentences.zh: 医生多次说过，做好准备吧。

sentences.en: I think it's the last moment.
sentences.zh: 我想这是最后关头了。

sentences.en: She had actually wanted to schedule her euthanasia after the end of February.
sentences.zh: 她实际上原本想把安乐死的时间安排在二月底之后。

sentences.en: And at that point, her mother was in a coma, and no one really knew what would happen.
sentences.zh: 而当时她的母亲正处于昏迷状态，谁也不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: I had a discussion with my father as well.
sentences.zh: 我也和我父亲聊过。

sentences.en: I told him, I don't know what to do anymore.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我实在不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: My plan was to do the euthanasia after mom's birthday, but now she is in this condition.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是在妈妈生日过后实施安乐死，但现在她变成了这样。

sentences.en: I can't do it.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: I can't do it.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: It would be very mean of me that you wake up and her daughter is away.
sentences.zh: 如果你醒来却发现女儿不在了，那我这就太自私了。

sentences.en: My father told me, Marike, you don't have to wait on mom.
sentences.zh: 我父亲对我说，玛丽克，你不用守着妈妈。

sentences.en: It will be always very, very hard for everybody, especially for my mom.
sentences.zh: 对所有人来说，这永远都会非常非常艰难，尤其是对我的妈妈。

sentences.en: And after, when her mom finally woke up and came to consciousness, Marike talked so fondly for the first time about how their family really became a family.
sentences.zh: 后来，当她的母亲终于醒来恢复意识时，玛丽克生平第一次深情地谈到了他们家是如何真正成为一个家庭的。

sentences.en: Before, we lived our own life.
sentences.zh: 以前，我们过着各自的生活。

sentences.en: Now we lived more together.
sentences.zh: 现在我们联系得更紧密了。

sentences.en: It was very special.
sentences.zh: 这非常特别。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: So does that give you hesitation to want to do it now?
sentences.zh: 所以这让你现在对安乐死有所犹豫了吗？

sentences.en: Because now your mom's awake, and she might leave the hospital soon.
sentences.zh: 因为现在你妈妈醒了，而且她可能很快就会出院。

sentences.en: So now do you feel like, okay, her birthday has passed, she's awake.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在觉得，好吧，她的生日已经过了，她也醒了。

sentences.en: Do you want to wait now?
sentences.zh: 你现在想等一等吗？

sentences.en: After Marike's mother came out of the coma, Marike sort of stopped talking about anything.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽克的母亲从昏迷中醒来后，玛丽克几乎不再提及任何事情。

sentences.en: She just stopped talking about it until the following fall.
sentences.zh: 她不再提起这事，直到第二年秋天。

sentences.en: Hi, sunshine.
sentences.zh: 嗨，小太阳。

sentences.en: I got terrible days.
sentences.zh: 我这几天太难熬了。

sentences.en: Today again, I got a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 今天又是一样，我浑身剧痛。

sentences.en: It's getting too hard for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说越来越难熬了。

sentences.en: I forgot to say to you.
sentences.zh: 我忘了跟你说了。

sentences.en: I decided to do the euthanasia.
sentences.zh: 我决定实施安乐死。

sentences.en: I don't want to have my 40th birthday.
sentences.zh: 我不想过四十岁生日了。

sentences.en: So, now you know the bad news.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在你知道这个坏消息了。

sentences.en: I hear you later.
sentences.zh: 我们回头联系。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Sunshine.
sentences.zh: 小太阳。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在机会来了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App 时，你的第一个月即可免费使用。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》App，免费畅享 30 天。

sentences.en: Ready.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: Ready.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: So, last year when you were close to choosing a date before your mother's birthday, we talked about how you envision the end of your life.
sentences.zh: 所以，去年在你母亲生日前夕差一点选定日期的那会儿，我们聊过你设想中的生命终点。

sentences.en: Who would be in the room.
sentences.zh: 谁会在房间里。

sentences.en: Has that changed?
sentences.zh: 这有变化吗？

sentences.en: Do you want your parents in the room now?
sentences.zh: 你现在希望你的父母在房间里吗？

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: What are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 你在想什么？

sentences.en: It's too tough.
sentences.zh: 太艰难了。

sentences.en: It's too tough.
sentences.zh: 太艰难了。

sentences.en: For them?
sentences.zh: 对他们吗？

sentences.en: For them and for me as well.
sentences.zh: 对他们，对我也一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think they die a little bit with me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们也跟我一起死了一小回。

sentences.en: So, who are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Still the same?
sentences.zh: 还是老样子？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is a beautiful ending, but that doesn't mean that there's something bad.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美好的结局，但这并不意味着有什么不好的地方。

sentences.en: It means, it's for me, a really good feeling and I'm really thinking about it and I really, I hope that it's April that I can do it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，对我来说，这是一种非常好的感觉，我真的在认真考虑这件事，而且我真的、我希望能在四月份实施。

sentences.en: Marike was really adamant that she wanted to end her life before her 40th birthday in early May and she was desperate to get all the bureaucratic steps done.
sentences.zh: 玛丽克非常坚决地想要在五月初四十岁生日之前结束自己的生命，她迫切地想要完成所有的官僚流程。

sentences.en: She needed three signatures from three different doctors, including her euthanasia doctor, Wim Distelmans.
sentences.zh: 她需要三位不同医生的签字，其中包括她的安乐死医生维姆·迪斯特尔曼斯（Wim Distelmans）。

sentences.en: She had to meet with one psychiatrist and also get a signature from that doctor.
sentences.zh: 她必须面诊一位精神科医生，并获得该医生的签字。

sentences.en: And for each of those appointments, she had to physically go to the hospital, which required having someone shuttle her back and forth on several occasions,
sentences.zh: 每一次预约，她都必须亲自去医院，这需要有人好几次开车接送她往返，

sentences.en: something that wasn't necessarily easy for someone like Marike, who didn't drive and who was in a wheelchair and who suffered from consistent seizures.
sentences.zh: 对于玛丽克这样不会开车、坐在轮椅上且经常癫痫发作的人来说，这绝非易事。

sentences.en: And I think it became clear that she still had so much to do before she could confirm her death date.
sentences.zh: 我想这很明显，在确认死亡日期之前，她还有那么多事情要做。

sentences.en: My euthanasia, I'm so mad.
sentences.zh: 我的安乐死，我太生气了。

sentences.en: Fuck, it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 操，这根本不可能。

sentences.en: If I have to make an appointment the 24th, I've never got an appointment so faSt.
sentences.zh: 如果我必须预约 24 号，我从来没约得这么快过。

sentences.en: I'm sad.
sentences.zh: 我很伤心。

sentences.en: I cry a lot.
sentences.zh: 我哭了好久。

sentences.en: I got your message and let's try and talk because, um, I know how sad you are.
sentences.zh: 我收到你的消息了，我们试着聊聊吧，因为，嗯，我知道你有多难过。

sentences.en: Is there any way that you might be able to do it or you think it will be impossible because the timing is just too short?
sentences.zh: 你还有没有可能办成，还是说你觉得根本不可能，因为时间实在太短了？

sentences.en: Anyway, sending, uh, love.
sentences.zh: 总之，送上，呃，爱意。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Hi, sweetheart.
sentences.zh: 嗨，亲爱的。

sentences.en: It's just getting really difficult.
sentences.zh: 事情真的变得好难。

sentences.en: My doctor called and I have to go to two different doctors who have to decide if my story is grounded or not.
sentences.zh: 我的医生打电话来了，我必须去看两个不同的医生，他们得判定我的说法是否合理。

sentences.en: And also the psychiatrist, but he's also on holiday until after Easter.
sentences.zh: 还有精神科医生，但他也要休假到复活节之后。

sentences.en: It's so boring.
sentences.zh: 太烦人了。

sentences.en: And eventually she just ran out of time.
sentences.zh: 最终她的时间还是用完了。

sentences.en: The doctors said that they were all going on vacation for Easter and that it would be impossible for her to make her early May date.
sentences.zh: 医生们说他们都要去过复活节假期，她不可能在五月初的那个日期实施了。

sentences.en: It's going so bad and I don't have any freedom anymore.
sentences.zh: 情况太糟了，我一点自由都没有了。

sentences.en: I'm getting 40 years old and I'm living like an old woman in my house.
sentences.zh: 我都快四十岁了，却像个老太婆一样被困在家裏。

sentences.en: The next date Marike chose was at the end of September, but this date would end up getting pushed back as well.
sentences.zh: 玛丽克选的下一个日期是在九月底，但这个日期最终还是被推迟了。

sentences.en: I was sort of on standby to go see Marike in September and to be with her at the time of her death.
sentences.zh: 九月份我差不多处于待命状态，准备去见玛丽克，在她临终时陪伴她。

sentences.en: And so we were in constant contact.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: At some point, Marike sent me a message saying that she had been rushed to the hospital with sepsis.
sentences.zh: 有一次，玛丽克发消息告诉我，她因为败血症被紧急送往医院。

sentences.en: She had an infection and she would need to stay in the hospital for two weeks at the end of September, which meant that her date would be pushed back.
sentences.zh: 九月底时她感染了，需要在医院呆两个星期，这意味着她的日期又要延后了。

sentences.en: And I couldn't understand why because, of course, I thought, well, if she's sick, couldn't they just end her life then?
sentences.zh: 我当时无法理解为什么，因为我理所当然地觉得，既然她生病了，难道就不能直接在那时候结束她的生命吗？

sentences.en: And that's just not the way it works.
sentences.zh: 但事情根本不是这样的。

sentences.en: She had to be cured first and then could go home.
sentences.zh: 她必须先治好病，然后才能回家。

sentences.en: Essentially, she was too sick to die.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，她病得太重，连死都不能死了。

sentences.en: So in the time that I had known Marike, she had selected three dates to end her life.
sentences.zh: 在我认识玛丽克期间，她一共选定了三个结束生命的日期。

sentences.en: The first date was pushed back because her mother ended up falling into a coma for several months.
sentences.zh: 第一个日期被推迟是因为她母亲最终陷入了长达数月的昏迷。

sentences.en: The second date was pushed back because of bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: 第二个日期因为官僚手续被推迟了。

sentences.en: She couldn't get the paperwork she needed.
sentences.zh: 她拿不到所需的纸质文件。

sentences.en: And the third date was pushed back because she ended up with an infection and was very sick.
sentences.zh: 第三个日期被推迟是因为她不幸感染，病得很重。

sentences.en: It was so ironic because the things that made living hard were also the things that made dying hard.
sentences.zh: 这太具有讽刺意味了，因为那些让活着变得艰难的事情，也同样让死去变得艰难。

sentences.en: Family, bureaucracy, and her own health.
sentences.zh: 家庭、官僚作风以及她自身的健康状况。

sentences.en: I decided I need to go see her in person.
sentences.zh: 我决定必须亲自去见她一趟。

sentences.en: And I showed up, I sat down, I pulled up a chair, and I took out my notebook and I took out my phone.
sentences.zh: 我赶了过去，坐下来，拉过一把椅子，掏出我的笔记本和手机。

sentences.en: And I said, we need to talk about where you're at.
sentences.zh: 我对她说，我们得谈谈你的现状了。

sentences.en: Do you still want to end your life?
sentences.zh: 你还想结束自己的生命吗？

sentences.en: Or is this, you know, now do you want to postpone as you've done in the past?
sentences.zh: 还是说，你知道的，你现在想和过去一样延期？

sentences.en: And she was absolutely clear she was ready.
sentences.zh: 她态度非常明确，自己已经准备好了。

sentences.en: And that's all she wanted.
sentences.zh: 这正是她想要的全部。

sentences.en: And that's when she picked up the phone and said, well, let's call Wim and see when he's available.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她拿起电话说，那我们给维姆打个电话，看看他什么时候有空吧。

sentences.en: And she called him and the date was October 22nd.
sentences.zh: 她给他打了电话，确定的日期是 10 月 22 日。

sentences.en: And so right then and there, she chose the date.
sentences.zh: 就在那分那秒，她定下了日子。

sentences.en: So then we went through everything.
sentences.zh: 于是我们把所有事情都过了一遍。

sentences.en: So I have, you will be in a red casket with white flowers.
sentences.zh: 我记下了：你会躺在配有白花的红色棺木里。

sentences.en: What type of flowers?
sentences.zh: 什么品种的花？

sentences.en: Tulips.
sentences.zh: 郁金香。

sentences.en: Tulips.
sentences.zh: 郁金香。

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: Or roses.
sentences.zh: 或者玫瑰。

sentences.en: Or?
sentences.zh: 或者？

sentences.en: Tulips or roses.
sentences.zh: 郁金香或者玫瑰。

sentences.en: Not both?
sentences.zh: 不是两种都要吗？

sentences.en: No, I think roses.
sentences.zh: 不，我想还是玫瑰吧。

sentences.en: You mentioned before you wanted butterflies to come out.
sentences.zh: 你之前提到过，希望有蝴蝶飞出来。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so explain again.
sentences.zh: 好的，那你再解释一下。

sentences.en: I want to make sure.
sentences.zh: 我想确信无误。

sentences.en: If they go outside with the cask, there will be a little box with white butterflies.
sentences.zh: 如果他们把棺材抬到外面，那里会有一个装有白色蝴蝶的小盒子。

sentences.en: Well, then, and they let them free as a sign that I finally release out of the body that's in pain and suffering.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后，他们把蝴蝶放飞，象征着我终于从饱受病痛折磨的躯体中解脱出来。

sentences.en: I'm so glad that you are here today.
sentences.zh: 我真高兴你今天能来。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I'm so happy about this.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: Lindsay, you know, you are really somebody that's really in my heart.
sentences.zh: 林赛，你知道的，你在我心里真的占有很重要的位置。

sentences.en: About 30 minutes later, her parents walked in the hospital room.
sentences.zh: 大约 30 分钟后，她的父母走进了病房。

sentences.en: Her father, Joss, and her mother, Odette, took seats by her side.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲约斯（Joss）和母亲奥黛特（Odette）在她床边坐了下来。

sentences.en: She immediately brought up, this is the new date.
sentences.zh: 她立刻提起了这件事：这是新的日期。

sentences.en: It will be October 22nd, and I really want Lindsay to be in the room, and I want her to take photographs of my death.
sentences.zh: 将会在 10 月 22 日，我非常希望林赛能在房间里，我希望她为我的死拍摄照片。

sentences.en: And Marika said, and I also want you in the room.
sentences.zh: 玛丽克接着说，我也希望你们在房间里。

sentences.en: And her mom started crying, and her father got a little choked up, like, finally, the invitation is there.
sentences.zh: 她妈妈哭了起来，她父亲也有些哽咽，仿佛在说，这个邀请终于来了。

sentences.en: Do you stay in Belgium until the funeral?
sentences.zh: 你在比利时会待到葬礼结束吗？

sentences.en: So it depends on what happens.
sentences.zh: 这取决于具体情况。

sentences.en: That's why I'm trying to figure out what the plan is.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我在琢磨接下来的计划是什么。

sentences.en: So I'll stay at your house.
sentences.zh: 那我住在你家吧。

sentences.en: After the euthanasia, I will move to a hotel.
sentences.zh: 安乐死之后，我会搬去酒店住。

sentences.en: So the evening...
sentences.zh: 所以那天晚上……

sentences.en: You can stay in my house.
sentences.zh: 你可以住在我家。

sentences.en: I know, but without you, once the euthanasia, I will feel funny.
sentences.zh: 我知道，但是没有了你，一旦安乐死完成，我会觉得怪怪的。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不知道。

sentences.en: Let's see how we feel.
sentences.zh: 到时候看我们感觉如何吧。

sentences.en: I will feel funny.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得怪怪的。

sentences.en: I think it will be very difficult.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会非常难熬。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's weird.
sentences.zh: 是啊，感觉怪怪的。

sentences.en: It's weird.
sentences.zh: 感觉怪怪的。

sentences.en: Without you, with you there...
sentences.zh: 没有了你，有你在...

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It's weird being with the dead one in the house.
sentences.zh: 家里有个快死的人，感觉怪怪的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Just alone, me and you dead.
sentences.zh: 就剩我们俩，我和你这个快死的人。

sentences.en: And my dose is going to move.
sentences.zh: 我的药量也要调整了。

sentences.en: I'm going to get you.
sentences.zh: 我要去找你了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I can see you bothering me at night, you know.
sentences.zh: 我能想象到我晚上去烦你的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Bothering you.
sentences.zh: 去烦你。

sentences.en: Every time when you sleep, putting my hand on your shoulder.
sentences.zh: 每次你睡觉的时候，把手搭在你的肩膀上。

sentences.en: And you're scared.
sentences.zh: 而你很害怕。

sentences.en: A week later, I had to fly to New York for my mother's 80th birthday.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我不得不飞往纽约参加我母亲的80大寿。

sentences.en: And at the same time, Andrew Kay, the writer on the story, decided to go visit Marie Kay one last time.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这个故事的撰稿人安德鲁·凯决定最后一次去拜访玛丽克·凯。

sentences.en: And it was a Saturday night, and she was having a sort of going away party before her death.
sentences.zh: 那是星期六晚上，她正在办一场类似生前告别派对的活动。

sentences.en: And I remember I was at a matinee with my mother.
sentences.zh: 我记得我和我母亲去看了一场日场电影。

sentences.en: That's sort of all my mother wanted for her 80th birthday, was that her four daughters were with her.
sentences.zh: 我母亲80大寿最大的心愿，大概就是她的四个女儿能陪在她身边。

sentences.en: Right as we're walking in, I remember I got a message from Andrew that he was at the going away party and that it was really emotional.
sentences.zh: 就在我们走进去的时候，我收到安德鲁的消息，说他在告别派对现场，气氛非常感人。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, I think it's really happening.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，我觉得这真的要发生了。

sentences.en: And suddenly, in that moment, it hit me that she was actually going to die.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，在那一刻，我意识到她真的要死了。

sentences.en: I left New York on that Sunday to fly back to London and landed Monday morning, literally went home for an hour, changed the clothes in my suitcase, grabbed my cameras,
sentences.zh: 我于那个星期天离开纽约飞回伦敦，星期一早上落地，真的只回家了一个小时，换了行李箱里的衣服，拿上相机，

sentences.en: got back to the train station, got on the Eurostar, went directly from the station to her.
sentences.zh: 赶回火车站，坐上欧洲之星，直接从车站奔向她。

sentences.en: However, she was in the hospital at that point and just sat at her bedside for like as long as I could and then asked her what time she wanted me to be there the next morning,
sentences.zh: 然而，她当时已经在医院了，我在她床边坐了尽可能长的时间，然后问她希望我第二天几点到，

sentences.en: which was the last day of her life.
sentences.zh: 也就是她生命的最后一天。

sentences.en: I woke up and I thought, this is the last day of her life.
sentences.zh: 我醒来时心想，这是她生命的最后一天。

sentences.en: And I calculated the amount of hours she still had to live.
sentences.zh: 我算了一下她还剩多少小时可活。

sentences.en: The time that she was supposed to end her life was about seven o'clock or eight o'clock that evening.
sentences.zh: 她预计结束生命的时间大约是那天晚上七点或八点。

sentences.en: So I remember thinking, OK, she only has about 12 hours to live.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得当时在想，好吧，她只剩下大约12个小时的生命了。

sentences.en: And what does it feel like to live out your last 12 hours?
sentences.zh: 度过最后的12个小时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: When I got to the hospital, I thought she might be sort of somber.
sentences.zh: 当我到达医院时，我以为她的心情可能会有些阴郁。

sentences.en: I had no idea what her temperament would be.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道她的情绪会怎样。

sentences.en: And when I walked in, there were already two friends of hers drinking kava with her at her bedside.
sentences.zh: 当我走进去时，她的床边已经有两位朋友在陪她喝卡瓦酒了。

sentences.en: And so she was laughing and joking around with them.
sentences.zh: 她正在和他们说说笑笑。

sentences.en: I mean, she was having the time of her life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她正过着她这辈子最开心的时光。

sentences.en: I felt like sort of the heaviness was more on me than on her.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那种沉重感更多是压在我身上，而不是她。

sentences.en: The most beautiful day in my life was the bandit jump and also winning the gold medal.
sentences.zh: 我生命中最美好的日子是蹦极的那天，还有赢得金牌。

sentences.en: Those two things.
sentences.zh: 就这两件事。

sentences.en: Her mother, Odette, looked beautiful that day.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲奥黛特那天看起来很漂亮。

sentences.en: She had her hair done and was wearing this very patterned, pretty sweater.
sentences.zh: 她做好了头发，穿着一件花纹很好看的毛衣。

sentences.en: And I just couldn't stop thinking, what must it feel like for Odette and Jose, you know, her parents?
sentences.zh: 我就是忍不住在想，奥黛特和何塞——你知道的，她的父母——会有什么感受？

sentences.en: Like, how do you walk into this moment?
sentences.zh: 比如，你怎么能走到这一刻？

sentences.en: How do you walk into a hospital room to pick up your child to usher them to their death?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能走进病房去接你的孩子，引领他们走向死亡？

sentences.en: We arrived back at the house and Marike kind of disappeared into the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我们回到家里，玛丽克不知怎么就消失在浴室里了。

sentences.en: And she was in the bathroom for a while.
sentences.zh: 她在浴室待了好一会儿。

sentences.en: When she came out, her house was already full of people.
sentences.zh: 等她出来时，她的房子已经挤满了人。

sentences.en: It was about 20 people came over.
sentences.zh: 大约有20个人过来了。

sentences.en: And Marike got onto the couch and fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 玛丽克走到沙发上躺下，睡着了。

sentences.en: She completely passed out for about two hours.
sentences.zh: 她彻底昏睡了大约两个小时。

sentences.en: People went and sat next to her, cried, talked to her, hugged her.
sentences.zh: 人们走过去坐在她旁边，哭泣，跟她说话，拥抱她。

sentences.en: She didn't move.
sentences.zh: 她一动不动。

sentences.en: I think she had medicated herself.
sentences.zh: 我想她可能吃了药。

sentences.en: Maybe at that point, she realized emotionally this was going to be difficult.
sentences.zh: 也许在那时，她意识到从情感上讲这会很艰难。

sentences.en: At that point, her father came to me and said, if the euthanasia doctors arrive at 7 o'clock and she cannot answer the question of whether she is ready to go through euthanasia,
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她的父亲走到我面前说，如果安乐死医生在7点钟到达时，她无法回答自己是否准备好接受安乐死的问题，

sentences.en: they will leave and it will not happen.
sentences.zh: 他们就会离开，事情就办不成了。

sentences.en: At about 10 minutes before 7 o'clock, Marike just sat straight up on the couch and said,
sentences.zh: 大约在7点差10分的时候，玛丽克在沙发上直直地坐起来，说道：

sentences.en: I'm back.
sentences.zh: 我回来了。

sentences.en: And she said, where's my kava?
sentences.zh: 她还说，我的卡瓦酒呢？

sentences.en: And she started drinking and eating chocolate and saying goodbye and laughing and having fun with her friends.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始喝酒、吃巧克力、告别，和朋友们开玩笑、享受快乐。

sentences.en: And the doctors came in at 7 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 医生们在7点钟进来了。

sentences.en: And then Wim came over to her and basically said something like, okay, we're ready.
sentences.zh: 然后维姆走过去对她说，大概是说，好了，我们准备好了。

sentences.en: And she had a half a glass of champagne and she chugged it and then asked for another
sentences.zh: 她喝了半杯香槟，一口气喝光，接着又要求来一杯，

sentences.en: and stuffed her mouth with Maltesers, which was her favorite chocolate.
sentences.zh: 嘴里塞满了麦提莎巧克力，那是她最喜欢的巧克力。

sentences.en: And then she offered chocolates to Wim and he sort of grimaced like, that's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 然后她把巧克力分给维姆，维姆做出了一副“太恶心了”的痛苦表情。

sentences.en: I'm not going to eat Maltesers.
sentences.zh: 我才不吃麦提莎呢。

sentences.en: You know, she asked for sort of a moment to finish eating and drinking.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她要求再给一会儿时间把吃的东西喝的东西弄完。

sentences.en: And then each one of the doctors took her by her hand and wheeled her down the hall and they prepared her for her death.
sentences.zh: 然后，每一位医生都拉着她的手，推着轮椅把她送下走廊，为她的死亡做准备。

sentences.en: Then at that point, they called in her parents for a private goodbye.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，他们请她的父母进来做最后的私下告别。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, Wim came out and said, okay, come in.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，维姆出来说，好了，进来吧。

sentences.en: We all filed into the room.
sentences.zh: 我们鱼贯走入房间。

sentences.en: I realized I had never said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我从来没有说过再见。

sentences.en: And so I very quickly ran over and just kissed her on the forehead and said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 所以我赶紧跑过去，在她的额头上亲了一下，说了声再见。

sentences.en: And it was very, very quick.
sentences.zh: 过程非常非常快。

sentences.en: And they started with the injections and the catheter in her neck.
sentences.zh: 他们开始注射，并在她脖子上插导管。

sentences.en: I continued photographing until she was officially pronounced dead.
sentences.zh: 我一直拍到她被正式宣告死亡。

sentences.en: And then we sort of all pulled away and gave the parents some time with her alone.
sentences.zh: 然后我们大家退了开来，给她的父母留出一些单独和她在一起的时间。

sentences.en: We stepped out into the hall and we all thought that Marike would want us all to open a bottle of kava for her.
sentences.zh: 我们走到走廊里，大家都在想，玛丽克一定希望我们为她打开一瓶卡瓦酒吧。

sentences.en: None of us could believe she did it.
sentences.zh: 我们谁都不敢相信她真的做到了。

sentences.en: That was what everyone said.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在这么说。

sentences.en: Like, she really did it.
sentences.zh: 就像是，她真的做到了。

sentences.en: She did it.
sentences.zh: 她做到了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是今天你还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times reports that new COVID infections have started to fall across the country, signaling that the Omicron wave of the pandemic has finally peaked.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，全国范围内的新冠新增感染病例开始下降，这表明大流行的奥密克戎浪潮终于达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: Through Friday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 截至周五，美国

sentences.en: was averaging 720,000 new cases a day, down from about 807,000 cases the previous week.
sentences.zh: 平均每天新增病例为72万例，低于前一周的大约80.7万例。

sentences.en: Even so, deaths, which typically lag infections, continue to grow, surpassing 2,000 a day.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，通常滞后于感染数据的死亡人数仍在继续上升，超过了每天2000人。

sentences.en: Those, too, are expected to fall in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 预计在未来几周内，这一数字也会下降。

sentences.en: And over the weekend, British officials said that Russia was developing plans to install a pro-Russian leader in Ukraine, perhaps as a prelude to an invasion.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，英国官员表示，俄罗斯正在制定计划，准备在乌克兰扶植一个亲俄领导人，这可能是入侵的前奏。

sentences.en: Russia denied the claim, but U.S.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯否认了这一说法，但美国

sentences.en: intelligence officials said that the British information appeared to be accurate.
sentences.zh: 情报官员表示，英国获得的信息似乎是准确的。

sentences.en: Russia has already deployed more than 100,000 troops to Ukraine's borders that could, U.S.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯已经在乌克兰边境部署了超过10万名士兵，据美国

sentences.en: officials say, attack at any moment.
sentences.zh: 官员称，这些士兵随时可能发动袭击。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Sayer Kavado.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由赛尔·卡瓦多制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Annie Brown, Wendy Doerr, and Michael Benoit, and engineered by Corey Schreppel and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 安妮·布朗、温迪·多尔和迈克尔·勒鲁瓦参与了剪辑，科雷·施雷佩尔和马里安·洛萨诺负责录音工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Rundberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由奇妙乐团的吉姆·伦德伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Andrew Kaye, Becky Leibowitz, Randall Archibald, and Andrew Doss.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢安德鲁·凯、贝基·莱博维茨、兰德尔·阿奇博尔德和安德鲁·多斯。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎进了一群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人热血沸腾的权力斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都会》节目中，我和主持人莎拉·科尼格一起，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: We'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.zh: 你
